candidate_equality_scope: Decoded candidate logits, log probabilities, reported probabilities, and typed-decision floating values compared by IEEE-754 binary64 bits against the sealed historical reference. Exact input/candidate identities and ordered coverage checked privately.
limitations: This audit inspected sealed records and file identities; it launched no inference.
Output equality preserves the measured reference behavior and establishes no new calibration or generalization evidence.
Process settlement is recorded in both validated process records; the audit did not continuously monitor background processes.

method.artifact_hashing: SHA-256 of all 66 bound files, including model and binaries; all 42 prior reference bindings compared unchanged
method.calibration: Temperature-1.22 stable softmax independently recomputed from candidate logits and normalized log probabilities
method.quality: First fresh response per case; public and synthetic populations independently recomputed
method.seals: Configuration, artifact snapshot, pre-run seal, post-run seal, worker and probe record hashes independently checked

timing_status: Deferred; no timing analysis or speed claim. Background Brekko was left running.
whole_vocabulary_scope: All 534 candidate-probe whole-vocabulary little-endian-f32 digests, plus three probe warmups, equal the preserved original-core probe. Historical-worker equality covers exposed candidate outputs only.
